name: domain-name-engine
description: Find a strong brand name and domain: LLM-driven naming with RDAP/WHOIS/DNS availability checks, brand research tools, and dated registrar prices for Spaceship, Namecheap, and Cloudflare.

spaceship_api_key.title: Spaceship API key
spaceship_api_key.description: Optional. Spaceship API Manager key with the domains:read scope. Live prices and availability.

spaceship_api_secret.title: Spaceship API secret
spaceship_api_secret.description: Optional. Secret shown once when you create the Spaceship API key.

namecheap_api_key.title: Namecheap API key
namecheap_api_key.description: Optional. From Profile > Tools > API Access. Your account must qualify for API access.

namecheap_client_ip.title: Namecheap client IP
namecheap_client_ip.description: Optional. Your public IPv4. It must be on the Namecheap API allow list.

cloudflare_api_token.title: Cloudflare API token
cloudflare_api_token.description: Optional. Custom API token with Registrar access. Live prices and availability (beta API).

cloudflare_account_id.title: Cloudflare account ID
cloudflare_account_id.description: Optional. Shown in the Cloudflare dashboard on the account overview.

github_token.title: GitHub token
github_token.description: Optional. Fine-grained token with no repository access. Raises the GitHub handle check limit.

reddit_client_id.title: Reddit client ID
reddit_client_id.description: Optional. Client ID of a Reddit script app. Enables the Reddit username check.

reddit_client_secret.title: Reddit client secret
reddit_client_secret.description: Optional. Secret of the same Reddit script app.

youtube_api_key.title: YouTube API key
youtube_api_key.description: Optional. Google Cloud API key restricted to YouTube Data API v3. Enables the YouTube handle check.

euipo_client_id.title: EUIPO client ID
euipo_client_id.description: Optional. Client ID of your app on dev.euipo.europa.eu. Enables EU trademark search.

euipo_client_secret.title: EUIPO client secret
euipo_client_secret.description: Optional. Client secret of the same EUIPO app.

euipo_env.title: EUIPO environment
euipo_env.description: Optional. Type sandbox for EUIPO test credentials. Leave empty for production.
